evidences.evidence_context: As for RFID-based methods, researchers have explored the possibility of using COTS RFID tags to perform the thru-the-wall eavesdropping on the loudspeaker [50]. Chen et al. [51] attached a low-cost RFID tag on the glass bridge to sense subtle facial speech dynamics and thereby achieve live voice eavesdropping.
